content: पुटः, -टम् [पुट्-क] .²1 A fold. .²2 A hollow space, cavity, concavity; भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वनानिलः <ls>R. 9. 68</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 23</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 12</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 9</ls>; अञ्जलिपुट, नासापुट, कर्णपुट <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 A cup made of a leaf folded or doubled; a vessel of leaves; दुग्ध्वा पयः पत्रपुटे मदीयम् <ls>R. 2. 65</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 28</ls>. .²6 Any shallow receptacle. .²5 The pod or capsule which envelops young shoots. .²6 A sheath, cover, covering .²7 An eye-lid (पुटी also in all these senses). .²8 A horseʼs hoof. .²9 A cloth worn to cover the privities. .{@-टः@} .²1 A casket. .²2 The contracting of anything. .²3 A folding of anything so as to form a cup. .{@-टम्@} .²1 A nutmeg. .²2 Two vessels joined together for medical purposes.
